subject: Re: SDLC evidence deep dive — CI token custody & code review artifacts
messages:
From: Alice Turner <alice@novatel.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: security@novatel.com
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2029 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: SDLC evidence request: CI token custody + code reviews

Hi Irene / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. As part of NovaTel's vendor SIG assessment we need a compact evidence package that proves the following for Redwood's hosted inference control plane:

- How CI credentials are issued and rotated (ephemeral token policy, issuer, TTL).
- Mapping of KMS keys used for production image signing and their custodianship (who can perform rotation or export).
- Code review history for the last two production releases (PR numbers, approvers, and any exception notes).
- Change management log for the May 2029 release that included the runtime kernel change.

Could you provide a single bundle (zipped) with redacted CI logs if needed, a short index file, and a small mapping spreadsheet for keys? Ideally we get this by EOD Friday so the assessor can validate on Monday.

Appreciate it — small attachments or links are fine.

Regards,
Alice Turner
Security Assessor, NovaTel Communications

From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: Alice Turner <alice@novatel.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2029 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SDLC evidence request: CI token custody + code reviews

Thanks Alice — got it. A couple quick clarifying questions so we deliver exactly what you need:

1) For the CI tokens: do you need the token issuance logs themselves, or an exported audit (timestamped events with actor IDs) + a summary of our ephemeral token TTL and issuer?
2) For the code review history: do you prefer a CSV of PR metadata (PR#, author, approver, merge date) or the raw PR pages/screenshots?

Soojin, Marissa — can you pull the May release changehistory and the KMS custodianship mapping? I can redact and assemble the bundle once we have the artifacts.

Irene Choi
Sr. Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, Alice Turner <alice@novatel.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 12 Jun 2029 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SDLC evidence request: CI token custody + code reviews

Irene / Alice — attaching initial artifacts. I placed the full, unredacted CI run logs in the internal bucket and will provide a redacted ZIP for external review. For now I include:

- sdlc-evidence-index.md (short README explaining files and redaction approach)
- code-review-prs_202904-202906.csv (PR#, repo, author, approver(s), merge SHA, link)
- changehistory-release-202905.tar.gz (CHANGELOG + deployment manifest)
- kms-key-custody-mapping-annotated.xlsx (key id, use, owner, rotation SOP link)

Notes:
- Ephemeral CI token issuer is our internal token service (auth-service), TTL default 15m, rotating via short-lived OIDC refresh.
- We do not export raw KMS keys; custody mapping lists human owners and documented rotation approvers.

Attachments: sdlc-evidence-index.md, code-review-prs_202904-202906.csv, kms-key-custody-mapping-annotated.xlsx, changehistory-release-202905.tar.gz

—Soojin
Product Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Alice Turner <alice@novatel.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: security@novatel.com
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2029 08:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SDLC evidence request: CI token custody + code reviews

Irene — thanks for the quick turnaround, this is helpful. A couple follow-ups from the assessor team:

- We need confirmation that ephemeral CI tokens are non-replayable and that token issuance events are logged to a tamper-evident store. Can you point to the audit sink or provide an exported sample (redacted) showing issuance + revocation?
- For the PR CSV: can you include any exception labels or comments where a PR was merged without two approvers (we tag these as "expedited-review" in our process)?
- For the KMS mapping: the assessor prefers an explicit list of current active key IDs and the last rotation date for each. Can you add a small column for that?

If you can provide a redacted CI run sample and the updated mapping by Monday EOD, that will keep us on schedule.

Thanks,
Alice

From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: Alice Turner <alice@novatel.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2029 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SDLC evidence request: CI token custody + code reviews

Alice — attaching the final, redacted package and a short response summary. Deliverables attached and links below. Key points first, then attachments: 

Summary highlights:
- Ephemeral tokens: issuance and revocation events are logged to our immutable audit stream (audit-stream-aws Kinesis -> S3 with object versioning + MFA-delete). A redacted sample (ci-issuance-sample-202906.zip) shows token_create, token_bind, token_revoke with actor IDs and non-replay UUIDs. Tokens are single-use for build jobs; we rotate their binding on each job run.
- Non-replayability: tokens are short-lived (configurable default 15 minutes) and bound to a single run-id; attempting reuse fails signature validation in the auth-service.
- PR exceptions: the provided CSV includes an "expedited_review" column and comments column with the approver who authorized the exception.
- KMS keys: kms-key-custody-mapping-annotated.xlsx now includes active KeyIDs and last_rotation_date. We do not export private key material; rotation proof includes the rotation event timestamps and rotation author.

Attachments included in ZIP: sdlc-evidence-index.md, code-review-prs_202904-202906.csv (updated), ci-run-logs-redacted.zip, ci-issuance-sample-202906.zip (redacted), kms-rotation-schedule.pdf, kms-key-custody-mapping-annotated.xlsx, changehistory-release-202905.tar.gz

Shared links:
- Evidence bundle (external): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AqR-sdlc-evidence-novatel
- Internal full run logs (for NovaTel reviewer access by request): https://redwood-internal.s3.amazonaws.com/evidence/REQ-8437/index.html

If the assessor needs a short walkthrough call (15 min) to confirm they can interpret the artifacts, Marissa and I are available Wednesday afternoon.

Best,
Irene Choi
Sr. Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sdlc-evidence-index.md, code-review-prs_202904-202906.csv, ci-run-logs-redacted.zip, ci-issuance-sample-202906.zip, kms-rotation-schedule.pdf, kms-key-custody-mapping-annotated.xlsx, changehistory-release-202905.tar.gz
